title: Unicode case-insensitive lookup
spec: Implement find_user(users, query). users is a list of display-name strings. Ignore leading and trailing whitespace in query, then return the first name in users that equals the query under full Unicode case folding, that is, name.casefold() == stripped_query.casefold(). Return None when nothing matches. Do not modify users.
target_defect: Matching uses str.lower() instead of str.casefold(), so names that differ only under full case folding do not match.
limitations: Synthetic module written by the repository's AI engineering agent after the November 2026 development pilot saturated corpus v1, before any model reviewed it. Designed around omissions, cross-function effects and edge cases stated in the contract. Not a natural pull request; correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks.
